title: a new-side sentinel after the last `+` line of a hunk that reaches the end of file leaves the result unterminated
notes: §12 item 23 (§1.3 'Final terminator'): the anchor block includes the file's last line, so the hunk reaches the end of file, and the sentinel follows the last `+` line (new side): the result's last line is unterminated, as `git apply` does. The sentinel is still dropped from the body (it is not a body line).
